dashboards.description: Production activity. DAU and WAU count profiles, including guests and automatic commits.

Account operation attempts and outcomes, not account totals. Signup receipts precede email activation. Successful activation attempts are separate. Current account totals and status come from CONTROL customer rows; profile hashes identify devices/profiles, not accounts.
Production signup and space activity. Seven-day signup cohorts; profiles, not accounts.

insights.name: Daily visitors (pageviews)
insights.description: Unique PostHog persons with a pageview, including guest profiles and unresolved anonymous visits. Memory-only identity can split repeat visits when identification fails. This is traffic, not active profiles, people, or accounts.

insights.name: Weekly visitors (pageviews)
insights.description: Unique PostHog persons with a pageview, including guest profiles and unresolved anonymous visits. Memory-only identity can split repeat visits when identification fails. This is traffic, not active profiles, people, or accounts.

insights.name: Traffic sources
insights.description: Page opens by source over the last 14 days.

insights.name: Visitor return with a local commit (legacy)
insights.description: Historical app_loaded cohorts returning with a local commit. Includes automatic commits and unresolved identities; not account retention or intentional engagement.

insights.name: Shell-to-space navigation funnel (legacy)
insights.description: Historical app_loaded to space-route pageview funnel. Measures navigation, not account activation or product readiness.

insights.name: Daily active profiles (successful user actions)
insights.description: Distinct profile hashes with a successful user-triggered product_event. Excludes startup, automatic work, anonymous identities, and failed attempts. Includes guests. Only releases emitting product_event are covered; missing rows are not zero usage. Not accounts or humans.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS period, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS active_profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'product_event' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND properties.result = 'success' AND properties.trigger = 'user' AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

insights.name: Weekly active profiles (successful user actions)
insights.description: Distinct profile hashes with a successful user-triggered product_event. Excludes startup, automatic work, anonymous identities, and failed attempts. Includes guests. Only releases emitting product_event are covered; missing rows are not zero usage. Not accounts or humans.
insights.sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp, 1) AS period, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS active_profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'product_event' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND properties.result = 'success' AND properties.trigger = 'user' AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

insights.name: Signups
insights.description: Completed account creation, before email verification. Last 30 days.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count() AS signup_receipts FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'account_created' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Activations
insights.description: Successful email-activation attempts. Last 30 days; not a current account total.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, uniqExact(properties.attempt_id) AS activation_attempts FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'account_event' AND properties.action = 'activate_account' AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND properties.result = 'success' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Pageview identity at capture
insights.description: Capture-time identity, not eventual person merging: profile IDs versus anonymous IDs. Reloads can produce new anonymous IDs. Compare to visitors after PostHog merges; do not add the identity counts as people or accounts.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, count() AS pageviews, uniqExact(person_id) AS merged_visitors, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS profile_ids, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, NOT match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS anonymous_ids FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = '$pageview' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Account attempts by surface and action
insights.description: Distinct started attempt IDs, separated by environment. One attempt can emit several checkpoints and one terminal event. These are operations, not accounts.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.surface AS surface, properties.action AS action, uniqExact(properties.attempt_id) AS attempts, uniqExactIf(distinct_id, match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS observed_profiles FROM events WHERE event = 'account_event' AND properties.phase = 'started' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, surface, action ORDER BY attempts DESC

insights.name: Account terminal outcomes
insights.description: Distinct finished attempt IDs by environment and result. Normal create_account completion can be blocked/awaiting_activation; account_created is the creation receipt and activate_account is a separate attempt.
insights.sql: SELECT properties.environment AS environment, properties.result AS result, properties.surface AS surface, properties.action AS action, uniqExact(properties.attempt_id) AS outcomes FROM events WHERE event = 'account_event' AND properties.phase = 'finished' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY environment, result, surface, action ORDER BY outcomes DESC

insights.name: DAU
insights.description: Unique profiles with a commit, space creation/join, or share each day. Includes guests and automatic commits.
insights.sql: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS period, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS active_profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= toDate(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND event IN ('commit', 'space_conversion', 'space_shared') AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

insights.name: WAU
insights.description: Unique profiles with a commit, space creation/join, or share each week. Includes guests and automatic commits.
insights.sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(timestamp, 1) AS period, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS active_profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 1) AND event IN ('commit', 'space_conversion', 'space_shared') AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

insights.name: Weekly retention
insights.description: Weekly return rate (%), grouped by first activity. Cohort size in each row; blank cells are not yet measurable.
insights.sql: WITH activity AS (SELECT distinct_id AS profile, toStartOfWeek(timestamp, 1) AS week FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND event IN ('commit','space_conversion','space_shared') AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY profile, week), cohorts AS (SELECT profile, min(week) AS cohort FROM activity GROUP BY profile), cohort_stats AS (SELECT c.cohort AS cohort, uniqExact(c.profile) AS profiles, if(c.cohort + INTERVAL 2 WEEK <= toStartOfWeek(now(), 1), round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(a.profile, a.week = c.cohort + INTERVAL 1 WEEK) / profiles, 1), NULL) AS w1, if(c.cohort + INTERVAL 3 WEEK <= toStartOfWeek(now(), 1), round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(a.profile, a.week = c.cohort + INTERVAL 2 WEEK) / profiles, 1), NULL) AS w2, if(c.cohort + INTERVAL 4 WEEK <= toStartOfWeek(now(), 1), round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(a.profile, a.week = c.cohort + INTERVAL 3 WEEK) / profiles, 1), NULL) AS w3, if(c.cohort + INTERVAL 5 WEEK <= toStartOfWeek(now(), 1), round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(a.profile, a.week = c.cohort + INTERVAL 4 WEEK) / profiles, 1), NULL) AS w4 FROM cohorts c JOIN activity a ON c.profile = a.profile WHERE c.cohort >= toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 1) AND c.cohort < toStartOfWeek(now(), 1) GROUP BY c.cohort) SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Week 0' AS week, concat(toString(toDate(cohort)), ' · ', toString(profiles), ' profiles') AS cohort, 100.0 AS retained_percent FROM cohort_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'Week 1' AS week, concat(toString(toDate(cohort)), ' · ', toString(profiles), ' profiles') AS cohort, w1 AS retained_percent FROM cohort_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'Week 2' AS week, concat(toString(toDate(cohort)), ' · ', toString(profiles), ' profiles') AS cohort, w2 AS retained_percent FROM cohort_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'Week 3' AS week, concat(toString(toDate(cohort)), ' · ', toString(profiles), ' profiles') AS cohort, w3 AS retained_percent FROM cohort_stats UNION ALL SELECT 'Week 4' AS week, concat(toString(toDate(cohort)), ' · ', toString(profiles), ' profiles') AS cohort, w4 AS retained_percent FROM cohort_stats) ORDER BY cohort DESC, week

insights.name: Returning profiles
insights.description: Profiles active in an earlier calendar week and active again. Same activity definition as WAU; current week is partial.
insights.sql: WITH activity AS (SELECT distinct_id AS profile, toStartOfWeek(timestamp, 1) AS week FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND event IN ('commit','space_conversion','space_shared') AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') GROUP BY profile, week), cohorts AS (SELECT profile, min(week) AS cohort FROM activity GROUP BY profile) SELECT a.week AS week, uniqExactIf(a.profile, a.week > c.cohort) AS returning_profiles FROM activity a JOIN cohorts c ON a.profile = c.profile WHERE a.week >= toStartOfWeek(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 1) GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: Signup → first space
insights.description: Seven-day conversion from signup. Mature signup cohorts only; counts are profiles.
insights.sql: WITH signups AS (SELECT distinct_id AS profile, min(timestamp) AS signup_at FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND event = 'account_created' AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY profile HAVING signup_at < now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), spaces AS (SELECT s.profile AS profile, min(e.timestamp) AS space_at FROM signups s JOIN events e ON s.profile = e.distinct_id WHERE e.properties.environment = 'production' AND e.event = 'space_conversion'  AND e.timestamp >= s.signup_at AND e.timestamp <= s.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY s.profile), shares AS (SELECT sp.profile AS profile FROM spaces sp JOIN signups s ON sp.profile = s.profile JOIN events e ON sp.profile = e.distinct_id WHERE e.properties.environment = 'production' AND e.event = 'space_shared' AND e.timestamp >= sp.space_at AND e.timestamp <= s.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY sp.profile) SELECT concat(toString(step_order), '. ', step, ' (', toString(percent_of_signups), '%)') AS stage, profiles FROM (SELECT 1 AS step_order, 'Signed up' AS step, count() AS profiles, if(count() > 0, 100.0, NULL) AS percent_of_signups FROM signups UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Created or joined a space', count(), round(100.0 * count() / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM signups), 0), 1) FROM spaces UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Shared after that', count(), round(100.0 * count() / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM signups), 0), 1) FROM shares) ORDER BY step_order

insights.name: Signup → create & share
insights.description: Seven-day conversion from signup. Mature signup cohorts only; counts are profiles.
insights.sql: WITH signups AS (SELECT distinct_id AS profile, min(timestamp) AS signup_at FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND event = 'account_created' AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY profile HAVING signup_at < now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), spaces AS (SELECT s.profile AS profile, min(e.timestamp) AS space_at FROM signups s JOIN events e ON s.profile = e.distinct_id WHERE e.properties.environment = 'production' AND e.event = 'space_conversion' AND e.properties.conversion = 'created' AND e.timestamp >= s.signup_at AND e.timestamp <= s.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY s.profile), shares AS (SELECT sp.profile AS profile FROM spaces sp JOIN signups s ON sp.profile = s.profile JOIN events e ON sp.profile = e.distinct_id WHERE e.properties.environment = 'production' AND e.event = 'space_shared' AND e.timestamp >= sp.space_at AND e.timestamp <= s.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY sp.profile) SELECT concat(toString(step_order), '. ', step, ' (', toString(percent_of_signups), '%)') AS stage, profiles FROM (SELECT 1 AS step_order, 'Signed up' AS step, count() AS profiles, if(count() > 0, 100.0, NULL) AS percent_of_signups FROM signups UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Created a space', count(), round(100.0 * count() / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM signups), 0), 1) FROM spaces UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Shared after that', count(), round(100.0 * count() / nullIf((SELECT count() FROM signups), 0), 1) FROM shares) ORDER BY step_order

insights.name: Joined profiles by channel
insights.description: Profiles that joined a space, including existing users. Last 90 days.
insights.sql: SELECT multiIf(properties.channel = 'clearnet_discovery', 'Discovery', properties.channel = 'organic_reshare', 'Shared links', coalesce(properties.channel, 'Unknown')) AS channel, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'joined' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY profiles DESC

insights.name: Signup profiles by channel
insights.description: Completed signups by source, before email activation. Last 90 days.
insights.sql: SELECT multiIf(properties.channel = 'clearnet_discovery', 'Discovery', properties.channel = 'organic_reshare', 'Shared links', coalesce(properties.channel, 'Unknown')) AS channel, uniqExact(distinct_id) AS profiles FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND event = 'account_created' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY profiles DESC

insights.description: Weekly successful operations in production.
